scenarios.name: discard-and-sacrifice-adds-three-of-one-colour
scenarios.why: 'Discard your hand, Sacrifice Lion's Eye Diamond: Add three mana of any one color' -- the whole hand goes to the graveyard as a cost, the artifact is sacrificed, and the chosen colour lands three deep in the pool.

pick: Sacrifice a permanent and discard your hand: Add R

scenarios.name: empty-hand-still-adds-three
scenarios.why: Discarding an empty hand is a cost paid vacuously: with no cards to discard the activation still sacrifices the artifact and adds three of the chosen colour.

pick: Sacrifice a permanent and discard your hand: Add G
